carrier: Cube27 ordinary split Green ring R localized at (2), its dimension-augmentation ideal I_(2), finite I-adic filtered modules, and the separately typed conductor Ext class

ring_finiteness_noetherian_input.project_authority: II-KB gives an integral monic presentation with 16 standard monomials, hence R is finite free of rank 16 over Z on the declared carrier
ring_finiteness_noetherian_input.local_consequence: R_(2) is module-finite over the Noetherian ring Z_(2), hence Noetherian

two_local_associated_graded.filtration: 0 subset 2M subset M; every integer-linear augmentation multiplication map preserves 2M functorially

conductor_ext_2local.at_2: NONZERO_PRESERVED: A2 tensor Z_(2)=A2 and Z/2 tensor Z_(2)=Z/2
conductor_ext_2local.away_from_2: ZERO: A2 tensor Z[1/2]=0 and Z/2 tensor Z[1/2]=0
conductor_ext_2local.pushout: detector pushes e to a nonzero epsilon in Ext^1_Z(Z/2,Z/2)=Z/2
conductor_ext_2local.yoneda_square: epsilon^2=0 in Ext^2_Z(Z/2,Z/2), since 0->Z --2--> Z -> Z/2 ->0 has projective length 1

completed_filtration_exactness.theorem_input: For a Noetherian ring and ideal I, I-adic completion is exact on finite modules (Stacks Project, Algebra Lemma 10.97.2 / tag 00MB; based on Artin-Rees).
completed_filtration_exactness.application: For every n, 0 -> I^(n+1)_(2) -> I^n_(2) -> gr_I^n(R)_(2) -> 0 is a short exact sequence of finite R_(2)-modules; completion stays short exact. Since I annihilates gr_I^n, its I-adic completion is itself.

stronger_completed_rees_claims.guard: exact completion preserves the short exact filtration sequences; it does not canonically split them or reconstruct the completed Rees algebra from gr alone
